name: Readwise Reader
tagline: Read-it-later app with highlights, RSS, PDFs, and spaced review

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Full/Readwise including Reader listed at $12.99/month monthly and $9.99/month annually.

verdictSummary: Saving articles and highlighting is easy; reliable extraction, mobile/offline reading, sync, Kindle/import integrations, RSS/PDF support, and review loops are real work.
coreLoopDIY: Build a browser save endpoint, article extractor, reader view, highlights table, export to Markdown, and review emails.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because all reading inputs flow into one durable highlight system.

priorArt.name: wallabag
priorArt.desc: Open-source read-it-later app with article extraction and self-hosted reading workflows.

notes: Useful because DIY covers 60% quickly but power users pay for the ingestion web.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Readwise Reader (Read-it-later app with highlights, RSS, PDFs, and spaced review). Requirements:

- Core loop: Build a browser save endpoint, article extractor, reader view, highlights table, export to Markdown, and review emails.
- Needs: hosted app.
- Needs: browser extension or share sheet.
- Needs: parser/extractor.
- Needs: database.
- Needs: email or notification service.
- Needs: optional OCR/PDF tools.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: excellent parsing; mobile/offline apps; Kindle integrations.
